rationale: Record that release-cli.yml crosses the design-output-and-packaging selector: it gains an ios-compile-gate job that runs test/cmake/test_ios_compile_gate.sh on the tag, on the darwin-arm64 leg's resolved runner, and the publish job now requires it. The per-PR iOS compile gate selection narrows to iOS-only surfaces and a nightly iOS gate workflow is added. Configure flags, packaging steps, archive contents and verifiers of the release legs are unchanged. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
